default.title: Drinking Water Points - Australia - OSM data
default.title_en: Drinking Water Points - Australia - OSM data
default.title_fr: Drinking Water Points - Australia - OSM data
default.description:
This dataset geolocates drinking water fountains and points in Australia.

It is based on OpenStreetMap data, which is then compiled and processed by Opendatasoft. It is updated monthly to retrieve the most recent OpenStreetMap elements. Fields prefixed with 'meta_' are additional information produced by ODS. These include data about the history of elements as well as their administrative divisions. Other fields are based on the Geodatamine implementation.

Tags

The OSM tags used to extract this data are:

  • amenity
default.description_en:
This dataset geolocates drinking water fountains and points in Australia.

It is based on OpenStreetMap data, which is then compiled and processed by Opendatasoft. It is updated monthly to retrieve the most recent OpenStreetMap elements. Fields prefixed with 'meta_' are additional information produced by ODS. These include data about the history of elements as well as their administrative divisions. Other fields are based on the Geodatamine implementation.

Tags

The OSM tags used to extract this data are:

  • amenity with the value 'drinking_water' or 'water_point' or drinking_water with values 'yes' or 'treated'
  • name for the water point name
  • cold_water, warm_water and hot_water for water temperature
  • fee to know if access is paid or not
Please note that this list is not exhaustive.
